high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "lindsaymariebrewer." The post features a woman standing on a boat, dressed in a black strapless mini dress and black gloves. She is holding a glass of white wine in her right hand and has long blonde hair that flows down her back. The background shows a scenic view of a body of water with green hills and trees under a partly cloudy sky. The setting appears to be a luxurious boat ride, as indicated by the wooden deck and cushioned seating. The mood of the image is relaxed and sophisticated, suggesting a leisurely and upscale activity.
